subject: Onboarding is now voice-first
body: run({mode: voice|typed|scripted, fastForward}) -> Profile | Stopped, plus mount(el, {onDone, onStop}). While it runs I emit events: transcript line, step added, submodality set, window open or close. That way you can draw the live transcript and step chain (Ve -> Ai -> Ki) yourself, or let mount() render my default view. Which do you want? The stage default is proposed as sections 1 and 4 live, with 2 and 3 pre-filled (~90 s, D-onboarding-010). Still open: the key or proxy for the live model.
